translation_notes: prefixes: SSTIM->sstim, ECO->eco, RDF->rdf, RDFS->rdfs, DCTERMS->dcterms, OWL->owl, PROV->prov, XSD->xsd

The region's module-level code depends on undefined names (ROOT, MANIFEST_MODULES, FULL_PROFILE, ONTOLOGY_DIR, parse_graph) that live elsewhere in the source file; added shim.py (context shim) providing minimal, faithful stand-ins plus small local Turtle fixture files for the context/catalog files it loads, so the region executes.

Both add-in-loop sites (merging artifact's own triples, and copying the profile predicates from the catalog) translate to +{ } inside the original for loops; the reading part (artifact.objects, catalog.objects, membership test) is left as ordinary rdflib calls since it drives a plain Python loop, not a bindings mapping.
